css-media.name: Write min-width as max-width, and the legend appears in a narrow window

css-responsive.name: Each of the two columns accounts for 50%. After adding the interval, the device card on the right side overflows.

css-transform.name: Misuse of translateY causes the scanning head to shift vertically

css-transition.name: only adds transition to the bright state, and the configuration is lost when the light is turned off.

css-animation.name: misses forwards, and the emergency sign will be returned to its original state after the animation.
